quote: In 1974, Robin Hartshorne stated his celebrated conjecture: If X is a nonsingular subvariety of dimension n of ℙᴺ, and if n > (2/3)N, then X is a complete intersection.
note: The conjecture concerns nonsingular subvarieties of projective space and their relationship to complete intersections in algebraic geometry.
